description: Know Center (KC) is Austria’s leading research center for trustworthy AI. As a renowned research organization with excellent science team, large partner network, successful business venture, and proven organizational structure, we apply for COMET funding for our ambitious research program on Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence & Data for Sustainability, Industry 4.0, and Life Sciences. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a universal tool, providing opportunities for solving global challenges and generating massive economic benefits in the twin green & digital transformation. However, the European population distrusts AI & Data. Europe must regain technology and data sovereignty and develop a vision of AI based on humanistic values to restore trust in the digital transformation. 360-degree vision for Trustworthy AI & Data. We have derived our 360-degree vision from EU’s definition of Trustworthy AI (TAI). Our interdisciplinary research will investigate technical robustness, safety, privacy, data governance, transparency, diversity, non-discrimination, fairness, accountability, as well as human agency and oversight. Our vision develops these requirements into scientific challenges and research fields and identifies application areas in business ecosystems, which together form a holistic and interdisciplinary research program for Austrian leadership in Trustworthy AI & Data.
entityDescription:
Know Center Research GmbH (KC) is Austria’s leading center for trustworthy AI research. With an outstanding team of scientists, a robust partner network, successful industry collaborations, and a proven organizational structure, Know-Center is committed to advancing the frontiers of data science and artificial intelligence (AI). Our current application for COMET funding is centered on a visionary research program addressing Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (TAI) & Data for Sustainability, Industry 4.0, and Life Sciences.
AI has emerged as a transformative technology, capable of addressing global challenges and driving the twin green and digital transformation, resulting in significant economic opportunities. Yet, there remains a pervasive mistrust of AI and data within the European population. Restoring this trust is critical, and Europe must take the lead in developing AI grounded in humanistic values to ensure technology and data sovereignty.
To address this, Know Center has developed a comprehensive 360-degree vision for Trustworthy AI & Data, aligned with the European Union’s definition of TAI. Our interdisciplinary research agenda will focus on the critical dimensions of AI: technical robustness, safety, privacy, data governance, transparency, diversity, non-discrimination, fairness, accountability, and human agency and oversight. We aim to transform these requirements into scientific challenges and new research fields, while identifying strategic application areas in business ecosystems that establish Austria as a leader in Trustworthy AI & Data.
The research program is structured around six core research areas—Data Management for AI, Data Privacy for AI, Methods & Algorithms for AI, Human-Centric AI, Fair AI, and Digital Transformation Design—each conducting cutting-edge research on fundamental aspects of TAI & Data. Additionally, three strategic projects will integrate this interdisciplinary research along the AI lifecycle, culminating in the development of open-source software frameworks: KnowAIDE, KnowTWINS, and KnowCERTIFAI. Furthermore, twelve applied research projects will foster AI specialization in three critical business ecosystems, in collaboration with a consortium of 40 company partners.
The success of this initiative is bolstered by a strong alliance of 26 scientific partners, supported by a network of over 280 European and 20 international leading scientific institutions. This extensive collaboration will enable us to drive impactful research and technology transfer to three key business ecosystems: (1) Environment, Energy, and Sustainability, (2) Production, Automation, and Logistics (Industry 4.0), and (3) Medicine, Pharmaceutics, and Health (Life Sciences). Our work will contribute significantly to Austria’s position in achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the EU Green Deal.

entityDescription: Masaryk Memorial Cancer Institute (MMCI) is the largest cancercenter in the Czech Republic in terms of the number of primarily treated adult patients with solid tumors and the provision of preventive cancer care. Almost 5 000 newly diagnosed cancer patients start treatment in MMCI every year. MMCI currently plays the role of the National cancer center in the network of Czech Comprehensive Cancer Centers. MMCI is an internationally recognized Institute, an accredited member of the Organization of European Cancer Institutes(OECI) and ESMO Designated Centre of Integrated Oncology and Palliative Care. MMCI is also a member of ERN network for rare adult solid cancers EURACAN and for genetic tumor risk syndromes GENTURIS. MMCI serves as a national node of the BBMRI-ERIC research infrastructure for biobanking and is a partner of Czech Clinical Research Infrastructure Network (CZECRIN). MMCI is providing health care services, research and education in the areas of prevention, diagnosis and treatment of solid tumors. MMCI is affiliated to Masaryk University, within which it cooperates with two other university hospitals, namely University Hospital Brno and St. Anne‘s University Hospital. MMCI operates its own facility for basic and translational research called RECAMO (Research Centre for Applied Molecular Oncology) and provides full support for clinical research, including Phase I Clinical Trial Unit, biobanking and precision oncology programme.

entityDescription: Photolitics is a speciality CMOS image sensor provider with its focus on high performance image sensors for industrial vision, medical imaging and endoscopy, high-speed imaging and scientific imaging. Since its incorporation in 2018 Photolitics focusses on the custom development and subsequent production of image sensors as well as on off the shelf speciality products for high added value markets such as industrial or medical. Over the years a sizeable IP library of silicon proven pixel IP from 1.6um up to 16um, both rolling shutter as well as global shutter with highest shutter efficiency, pixels are available. Photolitics is also expert in ultra high speed ADC development and high data rate serial interfaces. These IP blocks permit to realize novel sensors with low risk and attractive time and pricing. Photolitics off the shelf product family is constantly growing. It has started with the high speed line-scan sensor family LS2G which offers a wide range of operating modes, single line mode, multi spectral line mode and even different pixel pitch operation modes are possible. entityDescription:
Carboneg Group s.r.o.

Carboneg stands for the innovative synergy between future-proof agricultural practices and environmental responsibility. By assisting farmers in transitioning to regenerative agriculture, Carboneg plays a key role in the development of sustainable and resilient food systems. Farmers engaged in the Carboneg program are financially compensated for their contributions to capturing carbon in the soil, enhancing water retention, and promoting increased biodiversity. In terms of revenue generation, Carboneg is harnessing the potential of carbon credit sales to cater to its corporate clientele. To be able to tackle the needs of local environments, ecosystems and communities, Carboneg works closely with its local Agents. Agents are responsible for signing up and onboarding farmers for the Carboneg program. Through its Agent network, Carboneg is currently present on four continents with farmers and ranchers operating their livelihoods on more than 150000 hectares of land. As the world of agriculture gets increasingly challenged by the loss of biodiversity, distorted water cycles and ever more demanding food supply chains, the scale of needed transformation is unprecedented. Carboneg is now looking for new Agents to be part of this pioneering change. This document unfolds the details about the synergy between the impact Carboneg is making directly and the opportunities it creates for its critical stakeholders, farmers and Carboneg Agents alike. The Manual serves as the primary guideline to successfully operate the Carboneg program. The mission of Carboneg is to contribute to carbon negativity and healthier soil. The vision of Carboneg is to sequester 1 billion tonnes of CO2 in the soil by the year 2030. Carboneg was born in the Czech Republic in 2021 as a spin-off project of the employee benefits service company Benefit Management Ltd. Carboneg as well as Benefit Management Ltd was founded by Mr Vaclav Kurel who currently serves as Carboneg’s Chief Executive. After almost half a year of its existence, Carboneg managed to attract around 27 farmers into its regenerative farming program covering around 3 000 Ha of land in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. In 2022 Carboneg expanded its operations further abroad, specifically through partnerships in Kyrgyzstan and Romania. By 2023, Carboneg extended its team to 17 members covering all key functions and is currently well established for further international development. By the end of the year 2023, Carboneg aims to cover the total area of 250000 hectares of cropland and pastures under its flagship Program.

By assisting farmers in transitioning to regenerative agriculture, Carboneg plays a key role in the development of sustainable and resilient food systems. Farmers engaged in the Carboneg program are financially compensated for their contributions to capturing carbon in the soil, enhancing water retention, and promoting increased biodiversity. In terms of revenue generation, Carboneg is harnessing the potential of carbon credit sales to cater to its corporate clientele. To be able to tackle the needs of local environments, ecosystems and communities, Carboneg works closely with its local Agents. Agents are responsible for signing up and onboarding farmers for the Carboneg program. Through its Agent network, Carboneg is currently present on four continents with farmers and ranchers operating their livelihoods on more than 150000 hectares of land. As the world of agriculture gets increasingly challenged by the loss of biodiversity, distorted water cycles and ever more demanding food supply chains, the scale of needed transformation is unprecedented. Carboneg is now looking for new Agents to be part of this pioneering change. This document unfolds the details about the synergy between the impact Carboneg is making directly and the opportunities it creates for its critical stakeholders, farmers and Carboneg Agents alike. The Manual serves as the primary guideline to successfully operate the Carboneg program. The mission of Carboneg is to contribute to carbon negativity and healthier soil. The vision of Carboneg is to sequester 1 billion tonnes of CO2 in the soil by the year 2030. Carboneg was born in the Czech Republic in 2021 as a spin-off project of the employee benefits service company Benefit Management Ltd. Carboneg as well as Benefit Management Ltd was founded by Mr Vaclav Kurel who currently serves as Carboneg’s Chief Executive. After almost half a year of its existence, Carboneg managed to attract around 27 farmers into its regenerative farming program covering around 3 000 Ha of land in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. In 2022 Carboneg expanded its operations further abroad, specifically through partnerships in Kyrgyzstan and Romania. By 2023, Carboneg extended its team to 17 members covering all key functions and is currently well established for further international development. By the end of the year 2023, Carboneg aims to cover the total area of 250000 hectares of cropland and pastures under its flagship Program.

entityDescription:
Guardian Space aims to transform how communities and professionals manage risks and respond to disasters through its innovative community hubs. These hubs act as localized networks that connect residents, businesses, professionals, and insurers, facilitating the sharing of resources, collaboration, and access to real-time disaster intelligence.
Under the Community Hubs umbrella, we offer tailored solutions for both individuals and professionals:
CommunityHub.me equips individuals and small businesses with tools to find insurance coverage, manage claims, and facilitate payouts. Partnering with insurance providers, this platform incentivizes risk reduction through discounted rates and community-based risk diffusion, ensuring users obtain the most appropriate coverage.
CommunityHub.pro is designed for EMTs, firefighters, police, and other experts who require advanced tools and dashboards to monitor and mitigate risks. It provides real-time insights across 18 disaster types, enabling informed decisions that enhance community resilience.
On the insurance side, our Insurance EVENT360 Dashboard offers a comprehensive view of community risks and claims. Insurers can track incidents, assess claims efficiently, and identify opportunities for risk reduction, fostering collaboration with communities to create tailored insurance solutions.
Guardian Space promotes a collaborative approach to disaster management and risk reduction, equipping communities and professionals with the necessary resources and information to build safer, more resilient environments.
Our success is supported by collaborations with key partners such as the European Space Agency (ESA) and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). Our innovations have been recognized by institutions including the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) and the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA).

entityName: Consorzio Interuniversitario Nazionale per la Scienza e Tecnologia dei Materiali - INSTM
entityDescription:
INSTM. The acronym may be short, but in the world of Italian and international research, it carries considerable weight. Indeed, INSTM, theNational Interuniversity Consortium of Materials Science and Technology, is the largest consortium of its kind in Italy, drawing on the expertise of no less than52 universities – and all those that are active in Italy in researching advanced materials and technologies. The individual universities' voluntary affiliation with INSTM allows their Research Professors and Fellows to participate in the Consortium's activities through the presentation of research proposals. In the last few years,over 2700tenured professors, research fellows, holders of research and scholarship grants and doctorate students have taken advantage of this opportunity, and the numbers are growing year on year.
This is a great success by any measure, especially if we consider that consortia like INSTM typically have limited budgets. Like other such organisations, INSTM's chargeis to unite and concentrate the efforts of its affiliatesto help them become more competitive both in Italy and abroad in securing funds and financing. And it is here that INSTM excels, providing the organisational, technical and financial support necessary topromote research activities in science and technologywithin its affiliate universities. Its efficiency in bringing together andmanaging their considerable talents creates an effective critical mass that renders them highly competitive in taking on innovative research projects. Such projects may benefit Italy's business community, or may support initiatives in the development of technology transfer, providing significant opportunities for the academic and industrial spheres to benefit from their mutual interaction.
The success of this strategy is undeniable. This is underlined by thesheer number and quality of the domestic and international projectsinvolving INSTM's research groups that have been financed to date. It is further confirmed by theConsortium's partnerships, developed right from its inception, with important public and private research organisations, laboratories and companies active in the sector.

description: Our Technology The Varadis radiation detection sensor is a microelectronic chip, specially engineered to be sensitive to high energy (ionizing) radiation. Small, robust and requiring no power to detect radiation, our cost-effective RADFETs (Radiation Sensing Field Effect Transistor) can be easily integrated into electronic systems. Our innovative technology enables us to offer the world's most effective and dynamic radiation monitoring components, devices and dosimeter systems to some of the globe's most recognized organizations.
entityDescription:
Varadis is a deep technology product company, focused on building and selling the world’s most effective and dynamic radiation monitoring components, devices and systems.
Varadis is a spin-out company from Tyndall National Institute in Cork , Ireland and are building a global portfolio of customers within the Space, Government, Industrial and Healthcare markets.
Varadis is also part on the European Space Agency BIC in Cork. Our RADFETs have previously been supplied to the International Space Station and programs such as NASA's Living with a Star Program, EuCPAD dosimeter for astronauts, GlobalStar, Rosetta, Gallileo, Alphasat, ESA's STRV-1c, JAXA's MDS-1 & SDS-1 and ESA's Chimera experiment.

Varadis Radiation Sensing Field Effect Transistors (RADFETs) come packaged as plastic or ceramic hermetically sealed, robust, discrete MOS transistors optimised for the detection of ionising radiation. 
They are small and lightweight, combining the positive features of zero power passive dosimeters and the dynamic capability of active dosimeters.
Varadis RADFETs measure radiation exposure or dose together with an associated reader which converts the measured quantity in the sensor into an absorbed dose measurement for the user.
Optimized for radiation sensitivity to ionizing radiation: gamma rays, X rays and protons, Varadis RADFETs are ideal for space applications, including housekeeping of satellites, space radiation environment studies, shielding analysis and monitoring of radiation-hardened electronic components.

entityDescription:
AviSense.ai Technologies: Innovative AI Solutions for Autonomy, Visualization, and Interactive Sensing
AviSense.ai Technologies P.C. is a spin-off enterprise originating from the Multimedia Information Processing Systems (MIPS) Group of the Industrial System Institute of the ATHENA RC and the Visualization and Virtual Reality Group (VVR) of the University of Patras.
AviSense is at the forefront of revolutionizing the automotive industry with groundbreaking Artificial intelligence (AI) solutions. Our products and services offer innovative solutions that leverage data, including maps and location information, to enhance the safety and efficiency of autonomous vehicles. By combining data with AI-driven scene understanding, perception and highly precise localization capabilities on a global scale, we provide comprehensive solutions that enable real-time 4D location awareness of neighbouring road agents, increasing significantly safety, energy efficiency reduction, and at the same time, driver situational awareness.
The motivation for founding AviSense was driven by the need to address critical challenges in the automotive sector, particularly in the context of autonomous driving. Safety Enhancement: We recognized the paramount importance of safety in autonomous vehicles and the need for advanced solutions to provide real-time situational awareness to both drivers and passengers. User Experience: We aimed to transform the passenger experience by creating interactive and intuitive Augmented Reality interfaces that would make journeys in autonomous vehicles safer and more engaging. Technological Innovation: Our team's passion for technological innovation, combined with a desire to contribute to the evolution of the automotive industry, served as a strong driving force.
